headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.93
summary: Frees launcher image caches and hints garbage collection before the game loads to reduce memory pressure on low-RAM devices.

items.text: Launcher image caches are cleared and a garbage collection pass runs before the game loads. Device captures showed thousands of major page faults per second while playing on low-RAM devices; freeing launcher-side memory reduces the pressure behind those stalls.
